item.title: OCaml Weekly News, 15 Sep 2026
item.description:
1. opam 2.6.0~alpha1
  2. tiny_httpd 0.22
  3. Owebview 0.1 — native desktop windows with a web UI, from OCaml
  4. OSEC-2026-18: Marshal integer overflow leads to out-of-heap read
  5. OSEC-2026-19: JOSE missing RSA signature verification
  6. OSEC-2026-20: Cstruct indexing bugs can corrupt filtered output and reverse parsing results
  7. Dune Package Management Support in VSCode
  8. Liquidsoap 2.5.x: a practical study of OCaml 5.x concurrency
  9. OCaml Public Security Meeting
  10. dead_code_analyzer 1.2.1 and 1.3.0
